name: Suhaj
registryBasis: ESA documents a survey/expropriation parcel and boundary description for a public school explicitly located in Sohag city (2023), giving direct city-bound land-mapping activity. The wider Sohag Governorate GIS protocol covers state-owned lands only. Neither source establishes a comprehensive private-parcel cadastre or anonymous vector access.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: No public anonymous parcel-geometry service or schema was found. ESA’s digital maps are delivered through a written request, review and payment workflow; its interactive map page lists directorates, not cadastral parcels. Direct GET of the official Sohag site timed out without an HTTP response. No personal, title, or parcel query was submitted.
scopeLimits: Evidence concerns Sohag Governorate government-land GIS inventory and a national survey authority’s map-production service. The 2017 report states work across governorate cities and villages; it does not establish current complete coverage of the WUP city center or ordinary privately held parcels. The searched governorate portal timed out on a direct HTTPS GET before an HTTP response.

officialSources.observation: Direct anonymous ESA page states that the Authority and Sohag Governorate agreed on a GIS program to inventory/digitize state-owned land assets and deter encroachment; this is not a public private-parcel feature service. Egyptian Survey Authority services include digital-map products and surveying services.
